@fix_value = 0.75

fix_manifest = {
	name = fix_manifest
	is_manifest = yes
	ratio_progress = {

		completed_amount_collection = collection:fix_members

		}
	}
}

fix_goal = {
	category = medium_term
	completed = { has_war = yes }
	complete_effect = { add_political_power = 50 }
